notes.title: Patch 3.7
notes.content:
[b]SUMMARY:[/b]
[olist]	[*]		New Season Pass and reworked Experience gain.	[/*]	[*]		Added a "Find Party" function in all game modes. 	[/*]	[*]		New Battle Royale Skins are coming very soon. They will be called Battle Royale XX.	[/*]	[*]		Made changes to AR statistics. This will be unnoticeable for players that use them properly, don't worry. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some small tweaks to a couple of snipers to avoid abuse. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to the Event Map.	[/*]	[*]		Improved the Wood Shield Barricade Model.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked Backpacks in Survival and added a new one.	[/*][/olist]
	 

	[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

	[u][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a Group Find function for any game modes. It works like the Battle Royale version. When selected, you can queue up and be group with other players looking for a party. 	[/*]	[*]		Added a "Party" chat into the ingame Chat window. You can talk to your party even if you're not in the same server.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some issues on the UI that could cause small crashes.	[/*]	[*]		Made small tweaks to some UI Pop-Ups	[/*]	[*]		We have moved the "My Offers" button in the Flea Market to its main page. It was very confusing for some players unfamiliar with it. Now you can easily navigate there to reclaim items not sold. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue that would cause some private servers from not running when they were first rented.	[/*]	[*]		[b]Adjusted the Account/Season Pass Experience gained. More information on that below.[/b]	[/*]	[*]		Updated the description of the vehicle spawners to make it clear where and how you can use it.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a bug where clan territory perks would not work when the territory was "vulnerable". 	[/*]	[*]		Limited the Firerate on Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns and Machine Guns when set to single-fire mode. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some tweaks to balance out better all Assault Rifles.	[/*]	[*]		Changed some things on the behavior of the spread on Assault Rifles to prevent abuse.	[/*]	[*]		Made some small adjustments to some Sniper Rifles. They were way too unbalanced as they were and especially in Arcade where they're fairly common, they were hard to fight against. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue that made it nearly impossible to hit vehicles in high speed.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug caused by having a backpack inside your backpack on a loadout. 	[/*]	[*]		Improved the SSAO option on both High and Ultra graphics settings.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some spelling mistakes in some localizations.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the description of the vehicle spawners to make it clear where and how you can use it.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]ITEM CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[u][b]MODELS:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Wood Shield Barricades: We have made an update on the Wood Shield Model as to have it with no holes that players can shoot from/into.

We have it backed up so if it doesn't feel good or right, please let us know. All feedback is welcome.
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c46be78fb8254a67f4d2390e06d6fd1463427f86.png[/img][/*]	[*]		Made a few changes to the "Office Building". There are extra steps to go up the stairs to avoid getting stuck. We have also removed some windows that were placed in front of the stairs.
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6bf73997d9310145b090a99d354e01fd7f1856ce.png[/img]	[/*][/list]
	[b][u]SKINS[/u]:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]Fixes[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed the glowing texture on the M4 Semi Pink Graffiti			[/*]			[*]				Updated the link to BananaJoe's Riot Shield			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the name on the Desert Eagle Purple			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the models of the M9 Helmets. On a recent update, they were updated to the wrong version. They should look better now. 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		[b]Additions[/b]		[list]			[*]				Added 3 new skins to the Chrome skinbox
				
				[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/551ed6fcc67449de5aa97dbb2b604433069428e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/65b5702c3a161ce8dddc0b79f2ab1b8aff665b68.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/ddf8a7517a22e06eb302cb6ff9d7b44dd3fa97b2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/a9889fb4db244c47653fda79471b8d0b868fb29d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/e2a8ea7e2c994da0a733901a63edd5a1772e121f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/8cc09f0efc2dc3021b5ea693740d82a1e212f38b.png[/img][/url]
				 			[/*]			[*]				Added 3 new skins to the Fun Edition skinbox
				
				[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/91dd89e42afa2775aa25b8cc628173adbec77535.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/22f82ff2f2530209b122c800b3881e2e16bf7b92.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/bdf45b07481200207036115285b6da018df81c04.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/1fabd5b636d191590320c9befd2dc9126eb383df.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/12990d5df75c91b4b21123d19cc26dee1750200b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/990091811bf10ee472578aa2f161b4ca225d149b.png[/img][/url]

				[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/d84b297665b1ee590d05e690618517516250725e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/e41d858b612f76d4111b33db67f549b3bd2a76c8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/60ee9effcd295f29b2676a0daecfa0b534fcc2bb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/178a61674932f5b448a9b27c9fe60ab7b51cab8d.png[/img][/url]

tags.feature: Added a "Find Party" function in all game modes.

tags.balance_change: Made changes to AR statistics. This will be unnoticeable for players that use them properly, don't worry.
Made some small tweaks to a couple of snipers to avoid abuse.

tags.feature: Reworked Backpacks in Survival and added a new one.
Added a Group Find function for any game modes. It works like the Battle Royale version. When selected, you can queue up and be group with other players looking for a party.
Added a "Party" chat into the ingame Chat window. You can talk to your party even if you're not in the same server.

tags.bug: Fixed some issues on the UI that could cause small crashes.
Fixed an issue that would cause some private servers from not running when they were first rented.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the Account/Season Pass Experience gained. More information on that below.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where clan territory perks would not work when the territory was "vulnerable".

tags.balance_change: Limited the Firerate on Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns and Machine Guns when set to single-fire mode.
Made some tweaks to balance out better all Assault Rifles.
Changed some things on the behavior of the spread on Assault Rifles to prevent abuse.
Made some small adjustments to some Sniper Rifles. They were way too unbalanced as they were and especially in Arcade where they're fairly common, they were hard to fight against.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue that made it nearly impossible to hit vehicles in high speed.
Fixed a bug caused by having a backpack inside your backpack on a loadout.
Fixed the glowing texture on the M4 Semi Pink Graffiti
Fixed the name on the Desert Eagle Purple
Fixed the models of the M9 Helmets. On a recent update, they were updated to the wrong version. They should look better now.

tags.feature: Added 3 new skins to the Chrome skinbox
Added 3 new skins to the Fun Edition skinbox
Added a new Battle Royale exclusive skinbox. It contains 20 different skins and can only be gotten from Battle Royale matches.
Since there are new events for 4 teams in the Event Map, we have added an "Event C" and "Event D" skins to it.
Added a new backpack called "Camping Backpack". It is a bit bigger than the "Military Backpack".

tags.balance_change: M40A1 Remington 700: Reload Timer changed from 1.0 to 3.0
XMR-32: Reload Timer changed from 1.5 to 3.1
We have increased the amount of Experience gained from both Account and Season Leveling as follows:
Learning a skin: 25 -> 50
Time played (BR): 1/min -> 10/min

Killing a player: 5 -> 20
Killing a zombie: 1 -> 5
Winning a match (BR): 100 -> 125
Calling a Airdrop (GC): 25 -> 100
Completing missions/contracts: 10 -> 35
Killing a Slicer: 25 -> 150
Killing a Alien Super Zombie: 15 -> 130
Killing a Toxic Super Zombie: 12 -> 115
Killing a Super Zombie: 8 -> 95
Contesting territories: 18 -> 35
Purchasing GC: 1/GC

tags.feature: We have also added 20 levels to it, making it a total of 50 (from 30).
We have also added a multiplier to the Experience gained from zombies in Survival as it is much harder to farm them, due to multiple aspects.
We have changed the way skins will be given as rewards for the Season Pass.
From now on there will be skinboxes on the Season and you will gain them in some of the levels.

tags.feature: We are intecreating one of our newest feature of farming. There are 2 types of lootboxes right now, the black one has common and the green one rare loot.

Player detection radius from the Secret Rooms has been increased. This means the loot won't respawn when a player is too close to the area.

notes.title: Patch 3.5 Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/12812ffe98d40a67de32bf6dca5c8a2b644dbcf2.jpg[/img]

	[b]SUMMARY:[/b]

	This is a small hotfix to address some issues related to the Medieval Event and the maps. We are also still adjusting the issue related to zombies lagging players in places with high amounts of zombies. 

	 

	[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

	[u][b]GENERAL UPDATES[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Vehicles now apply a handbrake to forcefully slow down the vehicle after exiting it, this prevents vehicles from rolling away and desyncing.	[/*]	[*]		Optimized Zombie Networking:		[list]			[*]				When zombies are far away from players or are part of larger hordes, their networking is limited to decrease the bandwidth used by their movement packets. This change has lowered the zombie network usage by 70%.			[/*]			[*]				This optimization fixes an issue where people with really bad connections suffered from ping spikes when farming the airport.			[/*]			[*]				When zombies are close to you, this system does not apply (unless there are more than 50 of them in a big horde around you).			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Bear Traps & Claymores will now grant the kill to the owner who placed them.	[/*]	[*]		Spawn protection will now sync properly when a plays has packet loss or high ping. 	[/*][/list]
	[u][b]MEDIEVAL EVENT[/b][/u]

	[b]MISSIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Changed the way the medieval event missions work. Now it will only counting if you pick the items up if they are spawned by the server.	[/*]	[*]		Changed the amount of zombies you need on the Massacre mission.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]OPEN WORLD[/b][/u]

	[b]MAPS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]MEDIEVAL[/b]		[list]			[*]				Added a no-ghost area to the castle part to prevent people from ghosting back in.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed a collision wall under the bridge which made it possible for players to see through.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	 

	[u][b]SURVIVAL[/b][/u]

	[b]LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Throughout this week, we will be adjusting the prices of the items in the marketplace.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[b]MAPS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO V1[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed some misplaced objects at Lone Tree Farm.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some terrain issues at Cottonwood where you were able to glitch inside rocks.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed a misplaced fence in Clearview next to the garage.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some terrain issues at Smallville behind Fire Station.			[/*]			[*]				Removed the trees on the streets next to Smallville.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some terrain issues at Frosty Pines around the Post Office.			[/*]			[*]				Added a clinic to Crystal Lake with medicine spawns.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]OREGON[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed some misplaced objects in Rio.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]MEDIEVAL[/b]		[list]			[*]				Added a no-ghost area to the castle part to prevent people from ghosting back in.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed a collision wall under the bridge which made it possible for players to see through.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the in-game revive bug.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[b]Estimated patch size: 50MB[/b]

	[b]Patch ETA: NOW[/b]

	[b]Estimated downtime: 15 minutes[/b]

	[u]Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.[/u]

	 

	Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these updates with your friends and followers!

	For any feedback about the game please let us know at [url=http://playnewz.com/feedback]http://playnewz.com/feedback[/url]

	If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at [url=https://suggest.playnewz.com/]https://suggest.playnewz.com/[/url]


	To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
	[b]Facebook:[/b] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/]https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/[/url]

	[b]Twitter:[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/infestationnewz]https://twitter.com/infestationnewz[/url]

	[b]Discord: [/b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz]https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz[/url]

	[b]Youtube:[/b] [url=http://www.youtube.com/c/InfestationTheNewZOfficial]http://www.youtube.com/c/InfestationTheNewZOfficial[/url]

	[b]Twitch: [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/infestationthenewz]https://www.twitch.tv/infestationthenewz[/url]

	[b]Website: [/b][url=http://playnewz.com/]http://playnewz.com/[/url]

	[b]Forums: [/b][url=https://forums.fredaikis.com/]https://forums.fredaikis.com/[/url]

	 

	 

	Best Regards,

	 

	// Fredaikis

notes.title: Medieval Event 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6abea7798ea69ef2e0dc784cf8dee22cafe310ab.png[/img]

	Dear players,

	It's FINALLY time to kick off an event we've been working on for the past 2-3 months! It is time to take New Z back to the Medieval days. This will be one of our bigger events and includes many exciting things like a NEW medieval map, many events, giveaways and competitions, medieval skins and much, much more!

	 

	Now, let's walk you through the details:

	[b][u]EVENTS[/u][/b]

	[u][b]MEDIEVAL SEASONAL LEADERBOARD[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		During the event, Medieval seasonal leaderboards will be active.	[/*]	[*]		Top 5 in each leaderboard in Survival, OW and BR will be rewarded: 10 boxes for 1st place, 5 for 2nd, 3 for 3rd, 2 for 4th and 1 for 5th place.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Start: Friday, June 5, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Monday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	 

	[u][b]PLAYTIME REWARD[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		We will reward those who played 25 hours or more during the event with 5 medieval boxes.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Start: Friday, June 5, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Monday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	The boxes will be rewarded at the end of the event.

	 

	[u][b]GLEAM GIVEAWAY[/b][/u]

	We will give away LIFETIME PREMIUM and 5 medieval skinboxes to 3 lucky winners! The giveaway will be posted on[b] June 9th [/b]on [url=http://playnewz.com/giveaway]playnewz.com/giveaway.[/url]

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/40b5689e696701c2242d0389b86dfcf48991c1bd.jpg[/img]
	 

	[b]Start: Tuesday, June 9, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Friday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	 

	[u][b]DOUBLE GD/SD/BT/CT & XP[/b][/u]

	We will run a Double Currency and Double XP event during the first week of the event! We want to give a heads up that Private servers may fill up quickly, but we have got an extra NA server to support the demand.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/8046d331f02ce9491117ec09c118763ef0e2bb25.jpg[/img]

	
	 

	[b]Start: Tuesday, June 10, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Friday, June 14, 12:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	
	[b]Start: Tuesday, June 19, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Friday, June 21, 12:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	[u][b]LIVE STREAM BY CHUPACABRA[/b][/u]

	A live stream event will be done on both 12th and 19th of June by our Community Manager Chupacabra with lots of fun and awesome prizes! More info about this in a separate post!

	[b]Start: Friday, June 12, 18:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	[b]Start: Friday, June 19, 18:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	 

	[u][b]COMPETITIVE EVENT[/b][/u]

	We will do a Competitive event in order to get players into this fast-paced, exciting game mode! At the end of the Competitive event, we will reward 10 random players who have played [b]3 competitive matches or more[/b] with [b]5[/b][b] Medieval Skinboxes [/b]each!

	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/8e4c2c860fb0d6d1c5de8d991e47d85932e10a19.jpg[/img]

	[b]Start: Tuesday, June 15, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Friday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)[/b]
	 

	[u][b]MEDIEVAL BATTLE ROYALE[/b][/u]

	We will activate our [b]NEW MEDIEVAL MAP[/b] in Battle Royale and make it medieval-style. Don't miss this out!

	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/38cfbcd1cc55153b599974998c7d47400ba66b43.jpg[/img]

	[b]Start: Tuesday, June 15, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Friday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)[/b]

	[b][u]CONTENT[/u][/b]

	A lot of content has been prepared for this patch! Skins, clothes and a dedicated map has been prepared!
	[b]Medieval 2020 Box:[/b]

	[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/478844734052499458/718378199507009576/Skinbox_Medieval_01.png[/img]
[list]	[*]		[u]Will be available in the in-game marketplace and findable in-game but very rar[/u][u]e.[/u]	[/*]	[*]		[u]Also dropped by Super Zombie and Slicer Zombies.[/u]	[/*]	[*]		[u]Will also spawn in secret rooms and on heli cras sites[/u]	[/*][/list]
	[u]Some of the contents in the box:[/u]

You will have 6 missions on this map which you can repeat all the time.
This map will NOT have a safe zone, so you have to log out and stash or join a different map to do so and might risk your good position.

notes.title: Patch 3.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/0de2d627a718e42f1726c89b4887b69b1dfb1094.jpg[/img]

	[b]SUMMARY:[/b]
[olist]	[*]		Fixed skins that didn't match the set.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed abusable bugs related to vehicled and secret cave.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some minor UI issues and cleaned it up.	[/*]	[*]		Added skins for the Medieval Event.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed objects around the maps.	[/*]	[*]		We are tweaking the loot from Helicopter Crashes, Slicers and Secret Rooms live from now on. Any feedback is welcome.	[/*]	[*]		We made a small change to the gun switching system. It now prevents abuse from it.	[/*]	[*]		Added new contracts/missions with Slicer body parts.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to multiple zombies. This issue most likely is the main cause of the ping spikes on areas with many zombies.	[/*]	[*]		Improved loot in some areas in both Open World and Survival.	[/*]	[*]		Changed the way loot spawns in Secret Locked Rooms.	[/*][/olist]
	 

	[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

	[u][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Made some small UI changes to have a cleaner look.	[/*]	[*]		Whenever you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if its a superior one than you had on.	[/*]	[*]		Oceania Servers have been removed from the Server List.	[/*]	[*]		Added a protection on changing weapons that was easily abused. 	[/*]	[*]		Reverted back a change that would cause your mouse to "escape" the Window when you had other menus open.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where players were able to open the ingame store while dead.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where you could use your "Taunt" command while typing in search bars in the GI or store.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the Tutorial Windows in English, German and Portuguese.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a few issues in the French translation.	[/*][/list]

	[b]GENERAL FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue with zombies that caused gathering too many of them at the same time. This SHOULD fix the ping spikes, but we will need broader testing. 	[/*]	[*]		Made a few changes to physics on cars versus players that allowed players to abuse and enter areas they shouldn't.	[/*]	[*]		You can open the "player list" (Tab Menu) while climbing up and down stairs.	[/*]	[*]		When you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if it's a better one than you had on.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue that caused an error when gifting a friend character clothes on the marketplace. 	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]ITEM CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]VEHICLES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed a visual bug that would show the wrong durability on vehicles.	[/*]	[*]		You are no longer able to repair vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste repair kits. 	[/*]	[*]		You are no longer able to refuel vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste fuel.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to Player vs Vehicles physics that allowed players to glitch and abuse those glitches.	[/*]	[*]		Normal Repair Kits will no longer repair vehicles with less than 25% durability left. For such cases a Premium Repair Kit will be required.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ZOMBIES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved textures and materials for the Slicer. This gives the Slicer a better appearance with more detail, especially on higher resolutions.	[/*]	[*]		Added two new unique items to the Slicer: Slicer Head and Slicer Blades. They can be acquired from Slicers and are needed for the Razer Blade contracts. 	[/*][/list]
	[img]https://i.imgur.com/TTm8fg5.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Rb6FtgM.png[/img]

	[b]LOOT:[/b]

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/o3tMajq.png[/img]
[list]	[*]		Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 	[/*]	[*]		Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	[/*][/list]

	[b]SKINS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]Fixes[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed some K. Style NVG textures that didn't properly match the rest of their sets. Those include: Pulse, Black Night, Helix, Modern Black, Battle Royale, Crimson, Camo and Digital Red. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some other Pulse skins. Their Glow Maps were not properly set and they now all have the same level of glow. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the M107 Recipe icon. It was missing.			[/*]			[*]				Renamed all the Sig Sauer 556 skins. They are now called Sig Sauer 556 "NAME". 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the Iron Sights on multiple Sig Sauer 556 skins. They were still using the unskinned version Iron Sight.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the AWP Tech glow map. Its glow was not properly set and it now matches the rest of the set. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the coloring of the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Gold. It now matches the rest.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the colors and wings on the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Desion.			[/*]			[*]				Improved the Blue Night skins set. The colors have been readjusted to its intended colors. It's now less "purple" than it previously was. 			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the description of the Sig Sauer 556 Skins.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed an issue with the sound on the Valentine Heart Katana Skin.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the texture on the M9 NVG Valentine.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed the model on the Heavy Armor Helix where the lower part of the armor would split from the rest when crouched. 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	
[*]		[b]Additions[/b]		[list]			[*]				Added a new skin set for the Medieval Event. You will see more details on them when the event starts.			[/*]			[*]				Added skins to be rewarded to Battle Royale 2019 Leaderboard Winners. These are 3 different skins. Rank 1 will receive a unique one, then ranks 2 to 10 will receive a different one and 11 to 50 will receive another one. These skins are unique and will be automatically applied on the accounts so therefore nobody else can get them.			[/*]			[*]				Added two new Toxic Skins, the K. Style NVG and Moto Helmet. They will be added to the Revolution Skinbox.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]OPEN WORLD[/b][/u]

	[b]LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time.	[/*]	[*]		Items from secret rooms will continue to be tweaked over time. 	[/*]	[*]		Items from the Slicer and Toxic zombies will continue to be tweaked over time.	[/*]	[*]		[b]New Contracts Added[/b]. They can be found around the world but they will also be in the Open World Contract Box.		[list]			[*]				Razor Blade I			[/*]			[*]				Razor Blade II			[/*]			[*]				Razor Blade III			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 	[/*]	[*]		Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	[/*][/list]
	[b]MAPS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO V1[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed a player spawn that had the player spawn inside a tree.			[/*]			[*]				Moved some objects that were blocking the entrance of a few buildings.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some terrain issues at Blue Ridge Safe Zone.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed a Helicopter Crash at the Airport that contained the wrong loot pool. The loot from it now matches other Helicopters.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]OREGON[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed a airdrop spawn where the airdrop was going through a building while landing.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]SURVIVAL[/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed an issue where your backpack would change when you picked up a smaller backpack. It now only changes if you pick up a larger one.	[/*][/list]

	[b]LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time.	[/*]	[*]		Items from secret rooms will continue to be tweaked over time. 	[/*]	[*]		Items from the Slicer and Toxic zombies will continue to be tweaked over time.	[/*]	[*]		[b]New Contracts Added[/b]. They can be found around the world but they will also be in the Survival Contract Box.		[list]			[*]				Razor Blade I			[/*]			[*]				Razor Blade II			[/*]			[*]				Razor Blade III			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 	[/*]	[*]		Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	[/*][/list]

	[b]MAPS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO V1[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed some misplaced objects at Norad Military Base.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed a building at West Boulder that had a door blocked by some objects.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]COLORADO[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed a gap in Norad where players could get stuck.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed a misplaced sandbag barricade at Camp Splinter.			[/*]			[*]				Fixed some flying objects in Whitestone Mountain.			[/*]			[*]				Buffed the military loot at the Airport.			[/*]			[*]				Reworked the zombie spawns at the Airport because of server performances. The amount is still the same, but 30% of them will spawn over time.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 
[list]	[*]		[b]OREGON[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed an airdrop spawn where the airdrop would go through a building when landing.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	 

	[b]Estimated patch size:[/b] 250MB

	[b]Patch ETA:[/b] 1 Hour

	[b]Estimated downtime:[/b] 1 Hour

	[u]Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.[/u]

	 

	Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these updates with your friends and followers!

	For any feedback about the game please let us know at [url=http://playnewz.com/feedback]http://playnewz.com/feedback[/url]

	If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at [url=https://suggest.playnewz.com/]https://suggest.playnewz.com/[/url]

	Best Regards,

	 

	// Fredaikis Team

notes.title: Patch 3.4
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dKnBTGD.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/9023-patch-34/)

	As planned we are releasing patch 3.4 including fixes and improvements and the new Season Pass 04. Next to that we are also releasing the new Pulse skin collection. We are working hard on the next upcoming event although it's not just ready yet. Expect more information about that soon.

	 

	Now, without further ado, let's jump in to the patch notes:

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Various new assets have been added to the game related to a future medieval themed event. More information about the Medieval 2020 event will follow soon.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue related to the recently added prefab spawn system. This is the system that for example controls the random appearing helicopter crashes on the maps. There was an issue that could cause the site not to spawn on private servers.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused players not being able to pick up particular items in secrets rooms.	[/*][/list]
	[b]VEHICLES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Improved / Updated textures for the racer vehicle.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug causing cars to de-sync with clients.	[/*]	[*]		You can no longer exit a vehicle while trying to glitch inside a locked area. People were using cars to glitch inside these rooms / areas. We'd like to remind all of you here that we have systems in place to ban players attempting this. Don't do it.	[/*][/list]
	[b]3D MODELS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Upscaled textures for the airfield control tower.	[/*][/list]
	[b]SPAWN SYSTEM:[/b]
[list]	[*]		We are working hard on the current spawn system in the game. We have heared your feedback and made according improvements: players will no longer always spawn in the exact location of the player spawn, but instead  spawn in a close area around that particular spawn. This will always be random. We hope aim to improve the current situation.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Medieval 2020 Event:[/u][/b][/u]

	The Medieval 2020 event will not start just yet, so hold on! With this update we are already teasing some of the content for you guys.
[list]	[*]		The vault NPC textures have been updated to fit the Medieval 2020 event style.	[/*]	[*]		The trading lounge has been updated to the Medieval 2020 variant.	[/*][/list]
	We hope you are all as excited for this event as we are. Stay tuned for more soon!

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/zkiJwJt.png[/img]

	[img]https://i.imgur.com/7ixzRAB.png[/img]

	(More pictures here: [url=https://imgur.com/a/w49ITgz]https://imgur.com/a/w49ITgz[/url])

	 

	[u][b][u]Season Pass 04:[/u][/b][/u]

	In this update we are releasing Season Pass 04. The pass will directly be available after the update in the in-game marketplace for 2000 GC. A lot of new, unique content has been created and added to the game for this Season Pass and overall we are very happy with the result.
	
	[img]https://i.imgur.com/RtfgG8i.jpg[/img]

	Based on your feedback we have created Season Pass 04 and there is a couple of things that we'd like to address and explain:
[olist]	[*]		This Season Pass will be available and over a period of time that is over 2 months. It will end on July 31, at 12:00 PM (CET) 2020. The reason for this length is so that everyone has enough time to potentially finish it and claim all the rewards from all the levels.
		 	[/*]	[*]		The levels and XP needed per level hasn't changed compared to previous passes. We are overall pretty satisfied with the current level and XP amounts so there is not really a reason (yet) to change anything around this subject.
		 	[/*]	[*]		New exclusive content has been added for the Season Pass 04. This goes from unique sprays and taunts all the way to skins. A lot of next-level looking skins have been added and will only be available through the season pass. (Screenshot below of the new "SVD Hell" skin that you'll only be able to get through Season Pass 04:)
	
		And no, this is not the ONLY unique skin / content for the Season Pass 04. [b]There is a lot more![/b]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/2mesrh7.png[/img]
		
		 	[/*]	[*]		There is also a dedicated key item (both for Survival and Open World) available in Season Pass 04. In this case, players can get the Season Pass 04 Key 7x for each Survival and Open World through the rewards.
		
		Players can use these keys to enter an exclusive Season Pass 04 zone that can only be entered by players with this particular key. In these areas players have a chance to find even more exclusive Season 04 Pass-only content. And yes, even have a chance on getting ANOTHER SVD Hell skin recipe.
		
		Risky? Yes. You'll have to venture through Colorado V2 and open the door, although since this is map based, you can also just go on your private server.
		Remember, you'll only receive 7 keys in total for both Survival and Open World each. You'll only have 7 tries as they key disappears from your inventory once the door is opens.
		
		Where are these "areas"? Well, they are caves actually. They are only on the Colorado V2 map for both Survival and Open World and there is only 1 on each map. You'll have to find the location yourself. Good luck!
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/4AFnvSy.jpg[/img]
		
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/SDRRMig.png[/img]	[/*][/olist]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for NVG Goggles Civilian.	[/*][/list]
	[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added a new skinbox: Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/LrVBokZ.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Custom Guerilla: Custom Guerilla Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/06Gf9et.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Heavy Armor: Heavy Armor Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/z4mcCGY.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the IBA: IBA Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZasN8P3.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the IMI Tar-21: IMI Tar-21 Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/OnwoYZ6.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the K. Style NVG: K. Style NVG Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/vXlpwrg.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Night Vision Goggles Civilian: Night Vision Goggles Civilian Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		[img]https://i.imgur.com/uGCzzhO.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Moto Helmet: Moto Helmet Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.

		[img]https://i.imgur.com/LsbeG04.png[/img]	[/*]	[*]		Added a new skin for the Wakizashi: Wakizashi Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qeNP9ER.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8930-patch-32/)

	It's time for another update and this time a lot more aimed towards beginning players where we have added tutorial screens, more translations and more language support over all. Next to all of this we are patching in the new "Tech" skins with the Tech Skinbox. We are also rolling out this update to patch in content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. More information about that event will be released in the near future.

	 

	For now, let's get in to the patch notes.

	 

	[u][b][u]Overall Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]GENERAL:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added various new content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. Easter secret spots have been added to all maps. Please note that once again these spots are already showing in the game but won't be spawning any loot until the Easter 2020 event starts.	[/*]	[*]		All the beginner missions that activate when joining the beginner training map are now translated in all available languages.	[/*]	[*]		The in-game chat font has been updated to a different one that supports more languages including Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Thai and more. There will no longer be weird block icons showing when using characters from a specific language. If you still experience issues with writing your language in the in-game chat please let us know so we can work on this.	[/*]	[*]		The character name allowance has been improved as well. We now allow characters to be created again with a lot more characters and letters from specific languages.	[/*]	[*]		The Steam friends system is now integrated in to the game. This means you can now see and invite any of your Steam friends from the game to come and play with you.	[/*]	[*]		Added a tutorial slideshow for new players. This screen can be accessed by pressing F1 in either the main menu or in-game. There is separate screens for the different game-modes and there is separate screens for in the menu and in the game. We have also localized these screens although we are not 100% finished with the translations and all the screens yet. More will be added in future updates.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added an option to enable / disable the automatic equip of gear and attachments when picked up or attached.	[/*]	[*]		Picking up a better helmet will no longer automatically switch the gas mask when a player is inside the radiation zone or when a night vision is enabled.	[/*][/list]
	[b]SERVERS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Support for Oceania servers has been added. This means this is now a new region added in the game. There is no servers running in this new region just yet but there will be a later specific announcement about this.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b][u]Item & Skin Updates:[/u][/b][/u]

	[b]UPDATES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Updated all Custom Guerilla Fallen Angel skins. We have reworked the wings just like we did on the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel skins. The wings look better, are in a better position and are more optimized.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Police Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Halloween 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Summer 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Valentine 2020 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the skinbox icon for the Winter 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.	[/*]	[*]		Updated the store icon and the recipe icon for the QBZ-95 Tech skin. This skin will also be added to the new Tech Skinbox.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Chrome texture. The skin should now be properly chrome again.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor BR Champion. It is now better rigged around the character and should fit any character better.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Purple skin. The wings are now chrome again instead of white glowing.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Desion skin. The wings are now chrome red-ish again instead of white glowing.	[/*]	[*]		Rank skins now also apply to Battle Royale team wins.	[/*][/list]
	[b]REWORKS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the VSS Vintorez (sniper) & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the VSS Compact & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Honey Badger & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the QLB & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the SVU & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Flashlight & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Hatchet & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Blaser & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the AWP & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the Bizon & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the P90 & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the MP5/10 SD & it's skinned variants.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the store icon for the B93r & it's skinned variants.	[/*][/list]
	[b]FURTHER WEAPON STATS REWORK:[/b]
	Continuing the guns rework, we have revisited prior changes we've made to SMGs and readjusted them to better serve their real purposes. 
	SMGs are made to be extremely powerful close combat weapons and they should not be strong at a high distance. The issue with their previous status is that, first of all, they had no pattern... Some were extremely strong at certain distances, while others were useless even at close range. Now, we've adjusted to make them at least a bit more logically similar (but not the same) as they all serve the same purpose. 
	Basically, we have adjusted damage, improved speed and spread while nerfing the damage distance on them. We also took into consideration each gun's fire-rate and clip size to make this fair. That way, they will adapt to your play style better and you will be inclined to use each one, depending on how you like playing (rushing and pre-firing, tap-shooting, waiting-and-shooting, spray-and-spray, etc...). 

	LMGs needed a rework as well, however this is very delicate. LMGs's current main purpose and use is for farming, especially for killing super/alien zombies so we had to tread carefully here. 
[olist]	[*]		We cannot lower their damage or it will affect their current main use, which we don't want to hinder. 	[/*]	[*]		We also can't make it too precise as they are extremely powerful for automatic weapons, with very high damage. 	[/*]	[*]		We shouldn't leave them stuck only for extremely close combat. 	[/*][/olist]
	So with these three things in mind, we have added the Spread Variation System to it, where the more you shoot the more spread it has, with a fair limit to it, so it also doesn't go to the sky. 

	Future tweaks may occur on these weapons in the near future, but for now, enjoy their new stats and try them out!

notes.title: Infestation: Battle Royale - OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RnWnALV.jpg[/img]

	Dear Community,


(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8876-infestation-battle-royale-out-now/)


	We are proud to announce that Infestation: Battle Royale is now officially released and available to everyone on Steam.

	We would also like to take this moment to thank all of those who have supported us along the way.

	 

	You can play Infestation: Battle Royale in 2 ways:
[list]	[*]		Through Steam at: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/[/url]
		
		or
		 	[/*]	[*]		Through our Launcher which you can download at: [url=http://playnewz.com/download]http://playnewz.com/download[/url]	[/*][/list]
	 

	For those with more further questions we have listed out an FAQ below:
[list]	[*]		[b]What will happen to the current Battle Royale mode that is already available in Infestation: The New Z?[/b]
		What started out as a beta has now grown so big that we decided it's time to make Battle Royale its own game. BR will be lifted out of New Z before the release and added to the launcher and Steam as a separate game. By doing so we hope to raise the attention of new players, and also players who are into Battle Royale games but not necessarily survival.  For the patch set for early March/late February we are bringing a lot of new content both to The New Z and Battle Royale such as Colorado V1 BR, massive vehicle improvements, performance optimizations, 64-bit gameplay, new loot with new spawn mechanisms etc.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[b]Can I still use my New Z Account? What will happen to my purchased content?[/b]
		Don't worry, you will still use the same account in order to log in. You will not lose anything from the splitting, all skins, sprays and other content which you've purchased in New Z will still be available in the new Battle Royale game.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[b]OK, so the accounts will be linked?[/b]
		Correct, things like experience, season passes, account subscriptions will still be synced over both games, just like before. If you make a purchase in Infestation: Battle Royale it will be available in The New Z and vice versa.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[b]What will happen to the older Battle Royale leaderboards from New Z?[/b]
		As this in a way means that Battle Royale is stepping out of Beta, hopefully with a great influx of new players - we feel that it makes sense to also reset the current leaderboards. This will be done on the Steam launch date - 4th of March - and high ranked players will be contacted and granted a special reward.
		 	[/*]	[*]		[b]I don't play Battle Royale, how is this beneficial for me?[/b]
		Our hope is that this will as well raise the public's attention to New Z and that it will help bring an influx of players to both games!

tags.feature: What started out as a beta has now grown so big that we decided it's time to make Battle Royale its own game. BR will be lifted out of New Z before the release and added to the launcher and Steam as a separate game.

For the patch set for early March/late February we are bringing a lot of new content both to The New Z and Battle Royale such as Colorado V1 BR, massive vehicle improvements, performance optimizations, 64-bit gameplay, new loot with new spawn mechanisms etc.

Together with the BR separation we are patching The New Z into patch 3.0! With the 64-bit additions and focus on performance improvements and bugs lately we think it's time for New Z to step into the next stage and we aim to bring you updates just like we have been for the past 4 years!
